items.exampleEn: The motorway was closed because of snow.
items.exampleZh: 高速公路因為下雪封閉了。

items.exampleEn: The bus station is next to the train station.
items.exampleZh: 客運站就在火車站旁邊。

items.exampleEn: There is a new bus stop in front of my school.
items.exampleZh: 我學校前面有一個新的公車站牌。

items.exampleEn: You need a driver's license to rent a car.
Is there a petrol station near here?
My aunt worked as a tour guide for ten years.
Stop when the traffic light is red.
items.exampleZh: 紅綠燈變紅時要停下來。

items.sentenceEn: Turn right at the traffic light.

items.audioEn: My sister just got her driver's license, so she drove us to the beach.
items.audioZh: 我的姊妹剛考到駕照，所以她開車載我們去海邊。
options: A tour guide from the hotel

items.sentenceEn: The bus stop is across the street.
We drove on the motorway for two hours.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在高速公路上開了兩個小時。

items.stemEn: Wait for the bus at the ____ over there.
items.stemZh: 在那邊的公車站牌等公車。

items.stemEn: Our ____ told us about the history of the castle.
items.stemZh: 我們的導遊跟我們介紹了這座城堡的歷史。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Sara took a bus tour in England. She met the group at the bus station at seven. Their tour guide, Peter, was funny and kind. On the way, they stopped at a petrol station to buy snacks. In the first town, Sara was surprised by the traffic. "In England, cars drive on the left," Peter said.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Sara 在英國參加了巴士旅遊團。她七點在客運站跟團員集合。他們的導遊 Peter 又風趣又親切。途中他們在加油站停下來買點心。到了第一個小鎮，Sara 對當地的交通感到很驚訝。Peter 說：「在英國，車子是靠左開的。」

questions.questionZh: Sara 幾點、在哪裡跟團員集合？
導遊 Peter 說了什麼？

referenceEn: I don't have a driver's license yet.
I do not have a driver's license yet.
rubricZh: 「駕照」用 driver's license（寫 driving licence 也可以）

items.promptZh: 導遊請我們在九點前回到巴士上。
referenceEn: The tour guide asked us to be back on the bus before nine.
The tour guide told us to return to the bus by nine.
rubricZh: 用 tour guide 表示「導遊」
「請我們…」可寫，例如 asked us to…、told us to… 等，後面接原形動詞
「九點前」可寫，例如 before nine、by nine 等
